changelog: 1.0.49: in extended mode, outside-library titles on the home screen use Jellyfin Enhanced's own cards and Request button again — JE 12.17 only loads its Seerr module on its own pages, so Reco+ now asks JE's loader for it (Reco+'s cards remain the fallback without JE or without Seerr). The web page Reco+ adds its script to is now revalidated on every load, so a browser no longer keeps an old script after an update.
description: Personal recommendations that replace Jellyfin's own.
name: Reco+
overview: Personal recommendations (full history, abandoned titles, sagas, Seerr requests, extended mode).
